caseName: J. F. Fitzgerald Construction Co. v. Pedersen
caseNameFull: J. F. Fitzgerald Construction Co. v. Pedersen
attorneys: Mr. William E. J. Connor for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for rehearing is granted and the order entered November 6, ante, p. 698, is vacated. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of New York is granted. Mr. Henry E. Foley for petitioner.
